title: Inbound Logistics: IT Toolkit: Delivering the Route to a More Efficient Fleet
summary: Richards Building Supply is transforming its delivery operations with Descartes. Featured in Inbound Logistics, the leading building materials distributor shares how Descartes' route planning and mobile proof-of-delivery solutions have helped streamline deliveries across its network of 60+ locations, improve fleet visibility, optimize routes, and provide customers with real-time delivery confirmation through digital signatures and photos.
